---
title: "Overview"
---

```{r setup}
source("_common.R")
overview <- targets::tar_read(corpus_overview, store = store)
run <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(pkg_root, targets::tar_read(run_manifest_file, store = store)))
```

This site summarizes **units of measure and their ecological context** in
Ecological Metadata Language (EML) records from the
[Environmental Data Initiative (EDI) repository](https://portal.edirepository.org).
It is the first deliverable of the plan to propose QUDT QuantityKinds (QKs)
with ecological context and to decide how and when to attach them to units.
Counts reflect **usage in metadata**, not authority. Methods:
`r doc_link("methods.md")`. Table definitions: `r doc_link("data-dictionary.md")`.

## Corpus at a glance

| Measure | Value |
|---|---|
| EML files (snapshot `r run$corpus$snapshot`) | `r num(overview$files)` (parse errors: `r overview$parse_errors`) |
| Scopes (EDI, LTER sites, and others) | `r overview$scopes_n` |
| Attributes | `r num(overview$attributes)` |
| Attributes with `standardUnit` / `customUnit` | `r num(overview$standard_unit_uses)` / `r num(overview$custom_unit_uses)` |
| Distinct unit names (case-folded) | `r num(overview$unit_names)` |
| Unit groups (QUDT unit or spelling-insensitive key) | `r num(overview$unit_groups)` |
| Unit groups used in one dataset / in 100+ datasets | `r num(overview$single_dataset_groups)` / `r num(overview$groups_100_plus)` |
| Unit uses mapped to a current QUDT unit | `r pct(overview$share_uses_mapped)` |
| Attributes / datasets with semantic annotations | `r num(overview$annotated_attributes)` / `r num(overview$annotated_datasets)` |

```{r versions}
#| layout-ncol: 2
plotly::plot_ly(
  overview$eml_versions,
  x = ~eml_version, y = ~files, type = "bar"
) |>
  plotly::layout(
    title = "Files by EML version",
    xaxis = list(title = ""), yaxis = list(title = "Files")
  )

plotly::plot_ly(
  overview$dataset_units,
  x = ~datasets, y = ~unit_groups, type = "scatter", mode = "markers"
) |>
  plotly::layout(
    title = "Long tail: unit groups by number of datasets using them",
    xaxis = list(title = "Datasets using the unit group", type = "log"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Unit groups", type = "log")
  )
```

## How units were mapped to QUDT

Each EML unit name was mapped to a **current** QUDT unit, first through the
`RCode_JP` reference mapping (kept only if the QUDT URI still exists), then
through a spelling-insensitive match key. Unmapped names are kept and grouped
by their match key.

```{r mapping}
interactive_table(
  overview$mapping |> dplyr::mutate(share_uses = round(share_uses, 4)),
  "mapping_sources"
)
```

```{r scopes}
interactive_table(overview$scopes, "scopes")
```

## Provenance

- Corpus: `r run$corpus$source`, snapshot `r run$corpus$snapshot`,
  `r num(run$corpus$files)` files (sample size setting: `r run$corpus$sample_n`;
  0 means the full corpus).
- QUDT: `r run$qudt$endpoint`, retrieved `r run$qudt$retrieved`
  (`r num(run$qudt$units)` units).
- Build: commit `r substr(run$git_commit, 1, 10)`
  (uncommitted changes: `r run$git_dirty`), config profile
  `r run$config_profile`, `r run$r_version`.
- LLM labeling enabled: `r run$llm$enabled`.
- Derived tables: [`data/derived/`](`r derived_url`).
